newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling drops vs dollar in trendless trade.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling drops vs dollar in trendless trade.

text.p: Kenya's shilling fell versus the dollar on Thursday in confused, trendless trade as the market continued to regroup after talk large dollar buying on Monday was possibly done on behalf of the central bank, dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 56.92 against the dollar from 56.80 on Wednesday. On the pound, it was posted at an average of 88.73 from 88.27.
"The market was thrown into a state of confusion as players stopped quoting interbank, with near-term dollar/shilling trade losing direction," a dealer said.
"Margins widened to as much as 50 cents, with most players squaring off in-house," she said.

A second dealer said "This instability has been attributed to a player who bought large chunks of dollars on Monday, with rumours rife that he could have been doing it on behalf of the Central Bank of Kenya."
"The market should settle down by tommorrow as more dollars from exporters flow into the market. Range for the day is 56.80/30," he said.
Dealers said overnight money market rates slid further to 17 percent as a result of Monday treasury bills redemptions.
